profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Amazon Robotics

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer in the Virtual Systems group.  Leading teams of software engineers and data scientists in developing simulation engines, models, and visualizations of robotic solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Scrum Master, embedded security certifier, and developer on the Simulation Engines Team.  We build simulation systems that enable users to create optimized designs which are essential to the success of automated fulfillment.  Leveraging AWS and running the latest AR software and firmware, our team models material flow from inbound, to fulfillment, to outbound, to delivery, enabling users to test new ideas and optimize robotic designs from inception to deployment and beyond.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Designed, developed and implemented high performing business software solutions using a wide variety of technologies.  Hands on experience with full software development life cycle (SDLC).  Developed and maintained excellent relationships with clients.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Developed and maintained incentives calculation and business intelligence reporting software for a large Fortune 500 credit and banking company.  Optimized existing code to bring down process times from hours to minutes.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web application development using PHP and MySQL

educations.fieldOfStudy: Embedded Systems Engineering, DSP Systems Engineering
